g.text: Ever sit there and think about how many people you've killed?
What a way to start a conversation.
Sometimes. Usually when I'm trying to fall asleep.
I think about it like a high score.
I played that game for a while. But they find a way in.
Heh. They don't promote soldiers for social skills.
Whatever gets you through the nights, I suppose.
Eh, you seem to have done all right.
I thought I did. Though I might be changing my mind.
This is the bit I never understood. How do you start talking about this kind of bullshit?
I won't force you to talk if you don't want to.
Not my job to figure that out for you.
Sol, that's bloody adorable. Thanks for the laugh.
Thanks. We'll try this another time.
I try not to think too much about what I've had to do to get through life. Because I don't have anybody to talk to about it.
I only had myself to talk to.
I've never even really had friends. You and the others are the closest I've ever come to... belonging somewhere.
At least you've had the option to talk if you've wanted to. But hey. If you need me? I'm here.
I'm not sure I like it when you make sense.
I can't do this today. But thanks. This...means a lot.
